scope: esk-init writes a portable ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} hook for a committed repo-scoped settings file and refuses to commit a machine-specific emitter path (ADR-0051); the portable-vs-absolute decision is keyed on the resolved user-level target, case-folded on win32

boundary.evidence: install/plan/apply logic only; no business rule relocated.

ownership.evidence: FOUND+FIXED: the portable-vs-absolute decision was derived from the --personal FLAG (a proxy) instead of the actual target; a user-level target via plain --settings ~/.claude leaked a dead ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} hook. Re-keyed on resolve(settingsDir)===~/.claude (userLevel), case-folded on win32 so a c:/C: drive-letter mismatch cannot re-open it.

dependency.evidence: additive boolean logic over already-imported homedir/resolve/join; no new dep or throw surface.

error-handling.evidence: wouldBeCommitted try/catch fails open to local by design (documented); refusal fires only on --yes write; dry run warns and exits 0; no new swallowed failure.

findings.title: --personal under repo-under-home wrote a dead ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} into user-level settings
findings.question: ownership
findings.evidence: round 1: emitterUnderTarget now starts with a user-level exclusion; canary runs raw emitter so would not have caught it. Test: --personal not portable.

findings.title: refuse guard exited 2 on a dry run (no --yes)
findings.question: error-handling
findings.evidence: round 1: committedFootgun single-sourced; die gated on --yes; dry-run plan prints a would-REFUSE warning. Test: dry-run prints plan, exit 0.

findings.title: decision keyed on the --personal flag, not the user-level target (sibling leak via plain --settings ~/.claude)
findings.question: ownership
findings.evidence: round 2: introduced userLevel = personal || resolve(settingsDir)===resolve(~/.claude); used in emitterUnderTarget and committedFootgun. Test: user-level target without --personal is absolute.

findings.title: userLevel equality was case-sensitive; win32 drive-letter case (c: vs C:) could re-open the leak
findings.question: ownership
findings.evidence: round 3 (PLAUSIBLE on win32, the repo platform): added samePath that case-folds on win32. Symlinked-home spelling left as a documented limitation (realpath throws on a not-yet-existing settings dir). Test: drive-case-mismatch user-level target stays absolute (win32-only).

findings.title: ADR-0051 claimed personal install unchanged
findings.question: error-handling
findings.evidence: reworded to target-keyed decision + win32 case-fold + symlink limitation.
